evidence.quote: In 1830, the Gansevoorts ended their financial support of the Melvilles

evidence.quote: Herman attended The Albany Academy from October 1830 to October 1831

evidence.quote: where it was published in February 1846 by John Murray in his travel adventure series. It became an overnight bestseller in England

events.long: Роман, на который ушло около полутора лет, не нашёл читателей.
